decision: deleted the extra duplicates and kept the original
reason: duplicates make the data confusing and inaccurate

issue: gender spellings that are not a code
reason: standardizing makes it possible to count how much of each there is in the dataset
theres only 3 sites, we want the data to reflect that
the 9999 age is not a realistic value, it is better to have those as blank

issue: weight column named wt_kg in visits_south.csv
reason: changing the name made it so visits north and south had the same naming for this column

issue: sbp sentinel 999 and readings outside 70 through 250
decision: made anything outside of 70 to 250 a 999
reason: easily able to identify what is not a good reading if it is set as 999

issue: impossible and loosely written visit dates
reason: it can be quite difficult to adjust date formats when there is a lot of variety
if it is the same patient id and visit time, then the duplicate is not needed
can get confusing if there is multiple of the same visit with the same site_code
